memories.content: The second-line team handles escalated warranty claims. They have a queue of claims and aim to respond within ten working days as per their quoted policy. They have received Rustam's claim and are aware of the ten-working-day timeline.

Rustam's escalated warranty claim for a failed washing machine was submitted to the manufacturer. Yesterday (2026-08-04), the manufacturer emailed Rustam stating that the second-line team will provide a decision within ten working days. The ten working days from 2026-08-04 end on 2026-08-18 (assuming weekdays only), but the hard cutoff is 2026-08-19T18:00:00+05:00. The second-line team has the claim details and can make a decision.
